title: Class by domain compositional prompt views
hypothesis: A factorized class-by-domain Givens coordinate over one shared coupled CLIP prompt basis will recover useful held-out class-domain prompt functions at lower payload cost than independent cell prompts, and will beat a parameter-matched additive coordinate on held-out-cell accuracy.
physical_object: One frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 plus one shared two-token text context and its projected visual prompt basis.
mirror_coordinate: Per-class scalar a_c and per-domain scalar b_d, combined as angle m_cd=a_c*b_d; the angle rotates the two text context tokens. The vision prompt is the shared projected basis, as in a shallow MaPLe-style coupling.
logical_multiplicity: One prompt classifier view per class-domain pair, including withheld Cartesian pairs synthesized from learned class and domain factors.
scope_deviation: A CPU ViT-B/32 two-token shallow coupled-prompt screen, not a reproduction of CoOp, CoCoOp or official depth-9 MaPLe. Prior MA-1024..1026 cover those native prompt families; this experiment isolates class-by-domain coordinate composition and a matched additive control.
controls: one shared learned coupled prompt (CoOp/MaPLe-style baseline)
independent cell prompts on observed training cells, with no learned value for withheld cells (capacity reference only)

data.classes: all ten CIFAR-10 classes; every class and domain is represented in training, while one deterministic class-domain cell per class is held out
data.holdout_rule: withhold pair (class_id, domain_id) where domain_id=class_id mod 4; evaluate only after prompt states are frozen
data.prior_experiment_exclusion: train and official-test image indices used by MA-1024, MA-1025 and MA-1026 are excluded

model_and_training.domain_schedule: round robin; held-out class-domain cells are excluded from every training batch
model_and_training.development_selection: No hyperparameter search; fixed seed is used only to validate the runner and development metrics are excluded from the primary fresh result. Any required change is frozen before audit indices are opened.

metrics.primary: accuracy on withheld class-domain Cartesian cells
metrics.storage_authority: actual self-describing serialized inference payload bytes; full bundle also charges cached backbone, tokenizer, processor and metadata

gates.success: Mirror is within 1 percentage point of the independent cell reference on observed cells, beats same-size additive control by at least 1 point on held-out cells, and reduces full payload bytes versus independent cell prompts by at least 25% without a material throughput loss.
gates.failure: Mirror fails any quality gate, the additive control matches or beats held-out accuracy, native shared prompt is equal/better at lower storage, or complete-bundle savings are negligible.
gates.not_established: Backbone/data assets cannot be verified, serialized-state replay fails, or official fresh split remains unopened.

deterministically_reconstructible_free: prompt tensors decoded deterministically from their stored payload

boundaries: no broad open-set or natural-domain claim
